annotations.text: Three directions for the advice site — same content, three personalities. The advice button works in each; click it to cycle. Pick a direction (or mix pieces) and I'll build it out.
Option A — Quiet counsel. Editorial and typography-first: advice as a considered quotation. Tradeoff: understated, little spectacle.
Option B — Loud. Brutalist fortune-cookie energy: advice as a punchline you can't ignore. Tradeoff: the humor sets the tone — reads less like serious guidance.
Option C — Dusk. Nighttime wind-down mood: soft glow, low contrast, one thought at a time. Tradeoff: reads more meditation app than utility.
